bio:
Aaditya is a Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI, working at the intersection of machine learning, data systems, and applied LLMs. 

He previously founded Embedded Reasoning, Inc. and spent over three years at Robinhood, where he led LLM-powered internal analytics initiatives and served as a subject matter expert for large language models.

Alex Bovee is the co-founder and CEO of C1.ai, the identity platform built to secure the agentic workforce. 

C1.ai connects humans and agents to enterprise systems with scoped access, enforced policies, human approval, and a record of every action. Before founding C1.ai, Alex was a product leader at Okta, where he led the authentication, security and privileged access management product lines and shaped Okta’s zero trust strategy. 

He also held senior product roles at Lookout, where he oversaw enterprise device security. Alex speaks frequently on identity, agent governance and the future of enterprise security. He holds an MBA from the University of Chicago and a bachelor’s degree from Cornell University.

André Kerr is Director of the Applied AI Lab at American Express, where he leads development of enterprise generative AI products from experimentation to global deployment. He builds high-compliance AI systems for regulated environments, drawing on a background in aerospace engineering and systems engineering. Previously he worked at Raytheon Technologies on propulsion and software systems for aircraft and engine performance. He holds an MS in Systems Engineering from Johns Hopkins University and a BE in Mechanical Engineering from City College of New York. He is also an instructor and mentor in AI, focused on practical, scalable and responsible AI systems.

Anne Moxie is a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Instacart, where she develops and scales machine learning solutions to power data-driven products. With a background spanning machine learning, data science, and technology research, she has previously held roles at WeWork and Nucleus Research, combining technical expertise with strong analytical and business insight. Anne holds a Graduate Certificate in Data Science from Northeastern University and has continued her education through MIT Professional Education. She is passionate about applying AI and machine learning to solve complex, real-world challenges while delivering measurable business impact.

Ayon Gon is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft specializing in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and agentic AI. He has led cross-functional engineering organizations, translating complex technical challenges into scalable products and execution strategies. His work spans multi-agent analytics platforms, knowledge graph driven workflows, and AI adoption across engineering teams. A Chicago Booth MBA and Microsoft Global Hackathon Grand Prize winner, Ayon is passionate about building autonomous, resilient AI systems that solve real operational challenges.

Ben is the Head of AI Solutions Consulting at Blitzy, where he helps enterprises accelerate software development and modernize their technology operations through advanced AI solutions. 

With a background in Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Consulting, he brings a unique blend of technical expertise and business acumen to solving complex enterprise challenges.

At Blitzy, Ben focuses on leveraging System 2 AI to transform traditional six-month development cycles into six-day turnarounds, enabling organizations to build and deploy software faster. 

Passionate about bridging the gap between technology and business, he works closely with enterprise teams to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact.

Buddhiraj Chapalgaonkar is an accomplished technology sales executive with a proven track record of driving revenue growth, P&L optimization, and Go-To-Market execution across complex software ecosystems. 

Joining meshIQ as Chief Growth Officer in July 2026, Buddhiraj leads the strategic expansion of meshIQ’s integration governance platform, bridging legacy middleware control with next-generation Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures.

His career spans executive roles at Cleo and Axway, where he established scalable GTM models for complex enterprise integration platforms, as well as foundational technical consulting leadership at Infosys. 

He earned an MBA in Strategy with distinction from Thunderbird School of Global Management and a Bachelor's in Electronics Engineering from SGGS Nanded.

Chris is a Principal Engineer focused on AI inference and technical marketing at Red Hat, where he works at the intersection of AI infrastructure, deployment, and enterprise software strategy. 

Passionate about building within high-growth environments, he enjoys collaborating with teams to solve complex technical challenges and improve the software development process. 

His interests span software planning, architecture, and creating strong technical foundations that support scalable products throughout the development lifecycle.

Francisco Garcia is a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Shopify, based in Boston. He previously held senior machine learning roles at Quince and Roku, and worked as a Machine Learning Researcher at Amazon. 

He holds a PhD and an MSc in Computer Science from the University of Massachusetts Amherst, where he also worked as a research and teaching assistant. His experience spans machine learning research and engineering across leading technology companies.

position: Senior ML Scientist & ML Science Manager
bio:
Guillermo Mosse Nusbaum is Senior Machine Learning Scientist and ML Science Manager at Wayfair, where he leads large scale machine learning and generative AI initiatives that improve product data quality, automation, and customer experience across millions of products and complex systems. With over a decade of experience in data science, machine learning, and software engineering, he has delivered high impact AI systems used in production at scale.

Originally trained as a mathematician, Guillermo combines deep technical depth with strong communication skills to translate complex AI concepts into business value. His work spans multimodal AI, recommendation systems, product tagging, and agentic AI research, and he focuses on applying generative AI to solve real world enterprise problems.

His work sits at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and innovation, with a focus on translating emerging technologies into scalable solutions that address complex business challenges in the retail supply chain space. He is particularly focused on the strategic application of agentic AI to unlock new opportunities for value creation and reshape how organizations make decisions and execute at scale.

Jason Bouska is a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft with deep expertise in software engineering, database technologies, and large-scale system architecture. 

Throughout his career, he has helped organizations design and operate high-performance, data-intensive platforms, combining technical excellence with an innovative approach to solving complex business challenges. 

Jason is passionate about building resilient systems, modernizing technology platforms, and enabling engineering teams to deliver impactful solutions at scale.

position: Senior Director, Business Strategy & Product Marketing - Okta for AI Agents
bio:
Jax Painter leads Go-To-Market strategy and activation for Okta’s AI Take-off Team, a CEO-backed business unit dedicated to commercializing and scaling enterprise AI security globally. 

A product marketing leader with over 15 years of experience across Identity and Unified Communications, Jax specializes in GTM execution, positioning, and driving market adoption for complex, emerging technologies.

Jeff is a Vice President of Engineering at DraftKings, he leads engineering teams building highly scalable, customer-facing platforms that power millions of users in one of the world's largest digital sports entertainment and gaming companies. 

With a background in engineering leadership across large-scale consumer technology, he specializes in building resilient, high-performance products, leading distributed teams, and driving engineering excellence. Jeff is passionate about modern software architecture, AI-enabled development, and creating technology organizations that can innovate rapidly while operating reliably at enterprise scale.

Jocelyn Sexton is Vice President of Marketing at Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) and a B2B technology marketing executive with more than 20 years of experience building high-performing marketing organizations that drive measurable business growth. 

She specializes in transforming marketing into a commercial growth engine through AI-enabled teams, data-driven demand generation and full-funnel revenue strategies.

Throughout her career, Jocelyn has led global marketing organizations for high-growth technology companies and Fortune 500 brands, including Emerson and Dover. Her expertise spans AI, SaaS, enterprise software and industrial technology, with a focus on aligning brand, demand generation and sales to accelerate pipeline and revenue. 

She has also led marketing integration for multiple acquisitions and is passionate about helping organizations adopt AI to improve productivity, decision making and marketing performance. Jocelyn earned her MBA from The University of Texas at Austin and has been recognized as one of Austin's Top 50 Women Leaders.

Joseph Thangraj, Ph.D. is Lead Data Scientist at Sanofi, specialising in generative AI and machine learning solutions across healthcare and life sciences. He has led cross functional teams to deliver end to end AI products spanning GenAI document generation, time series forecasting, NLP, and optimisation systems, with a focus on driving measurable business and clinical impact.

With a PhD in Computational Geophysics and an IIT background, Joseph combines strong theoretical grounding with hands on engineering expertise. His work includes deploying production grade AI systems on AWS, building scalable ETL pipelines, and applying deep learning to complex healthcare and industrial problems. At the summit, he brings practical insight into building trusted, production ready GenAI systems in regulated environments.

Kishore Aradhya is Head of Data Products & Engineering at Advisor360°, with 20+ years of experience leading data, engineering and AI initiatives across enterprises including Bose, Adobe and Stanley Black & Decker. He specialises in data engineering, knowledge graphs, semantic modelling and agentic AI, helping organisations build trustworthy, scalable AI systems. 

An adjunct professor at Northeastern University, he has developed and taught graduate courses in Data Engineering and Generative AI with Knowledge Graphs. He is also a speaker, board advisor and CDO Magazine editorial board member.

Kranthi Manchikanti is an Agentic AI Solutions Architect at Microsoft, where he helps enterprises design and deploy production-grade AI systems using modern agent frameworks and cloud platforms. Previously at AWS and Oracle, he has extensive experience in AI architecture, cloud modernization, and enterprise transformation. 

Kranthi is also the author of The AI Runtime, a technical newsletter focused on AI reliability, agentic systems, and the practical challenges of deploying AI at scale.

Manish Kavuturi is a Generative AI Engineer at FedEx, where he works on building enterprise-grade AI systems for logistics intelligence. He develops production-ready GenAI platforms using LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows to enable natural language querying, document automation, and intelligent search across large-scale operational data. His work supports improved shipment visibility, root-cause analysis, and faster customer query resolution in complex logistics environments.

With over six years of experience across AI engineering and backend development roles at companies including FedEx, Conduent, and Dell Technologies, Manish has built scalable data pipelines, FastAPI microservices, and cloud-native AI systems deployed on Azure and AWS. He specialises in combining retrieval systems, MLOps practices, and observability tooling to deliver reliable, high-impact AI solutions in production.

Security teams have gotten good at finding vulnerabilities. Closing them is the problem. The median critical vulnerability takes 43 days to fix, and only 1 in 4 on CISA's actively exploited list is fully remediated. This session covers what remediation needs to work at enterprise scale. You'll leave with five questions to score any remediation tool or workflow: codebase context, reachability, release awareness, approved sign-off, and proof.

Neeraj is Field CTO at Blitzy, bringing over 25 years of experience in AI/ML, multimodal systems, and enterprise software engineering. 

He works closely with enterprise customers to design and deploy autonomous software development solutions, focusing on architecture, security, and production reliability.

Previously, Neeraj led the transformation of Microsoft’s Dynamics 365 Contact Center through agentic AI and advanced speech recognition technologies. 

He also held technical leadership roles at Nuance and Dragon Systems, developing enterprise and healthcare speech recognition platforms. His expertise spans agentic orchestration, responsible AI, and scaling AI systems from research to production.

Nitin brings over 20 years of progressive technology leadership experience spanning enterprise technology strategy, cloud data platforms, and AI platform engineering. 

His journey has been marked by pioneering the development of large-scale and cutting-edge products, platforms, programs, and solutions underpinned by optimization, statistical learning, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques. Grounded in first-principles thinking and innovation, Nitin's leadership remains a pivotal driving force in strengthening business outcomes while elevating customer experiences.

Currently, Nitin heads AI at The Mutual Group as the VP of AI Engineering. Previously, he co-founded Manifold Systems, an enterprise agentic AI platform startup, and served as VP of Technology & AI at The Aspen Group as well as VP of Digital Solutions & AI Platform Engineering at Staples. 

Earlier experience includes roles at FICO, Amazon, and Zulily. He holds an Executive MBA from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, a Master of Science in Operations Research from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, and a Bachelor of Technology from IIT Madras.

Omer Lang is a Senior ML Scientist on Wayfair’s Product & Content Intelligence team. His work focuses on building production-scale GenAI systems for data quality management and using AI to accelerate R&D.

Patrick Falvey is a Member of Technical Staff in OpenAI’s security organization, where he helps build and secure frontier AI deployments for the public sector. 

His work spans the full deployment lifecycle, from security architecture and hands-on engineering to production operations in regulated environments. He works with government defenders to apply AI to vulnerability discovery and remediation. Before joining OpenAI, he held roles in software engineering, cybersecurity, and forward-deployed engineering. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Notre Dame.

Paul Brownell is CTO at Growth Acceleration Partners, where he leads software and engineering strategy focused on scaling enterprise technology teams and modernizing software delivery. 

With deep experience across product strategy, Agile development, and large-scale engineering operations, Paul has built a reputation for driving cultural transformation within global software organizations. 

His expertise spans agentic engineering processes, software lifecycle management, enterprise systems, and aligning technical execution with business goals. 

Throughout his career, he has led worldwide teams, improved product quality and delivery performance, integrated acquisitions and OEM technologies, and helped organizations evolve from technology-led to market-driven operations.

Peter Yu is a Senior Applied Scientist at AWS, specialising in applied AI, agentic AI development, and generative AI. He works with enterprise customers to take AI solutions from experimental concepts to production, building custom agentic and multimodal systems aligned with business objectives. 

Previously at McKinsey, he led data science initiatives that improved operational efficiency and helped organisations solve complex business challenges using machine learning, NLP, and data visualisation.

Prasanna is a Senior Product Lead at ADP, where he drives innovation in AI and conversational platforms for enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) products. 

He leads strategy and execution for enterprise AI agents, large-scale language model evaluation, and human-centered conversational experiences that simplify complex HR workflows. Prasanna’s work bridges the technical and human sides of AI, focusing on scalable architectures and real-world product impact. 

A passionate mentor, he regularly shares insights at industry events and academic forums to inspire the next generation of product and AI leaders.

Priyanka Pande is a Product Manager at Capital One, where she has built enterprise observability, developer, and data products in financial services. Her career spans banking, insurance, and AI startups, focusing on taking AI from early ideas to products people actually use. 

Beyond her day job, Priyanka is passionate about entrepreneurship and is actively involved with Women in Product and Products that Count (PTC), where she organizes events, mentors, and loves bringing the product and tech community together. She is passionate about making AI practical, responsible, and accessible to the people it’s meant to serve

Pushpjeet Shrivastava is a Network and Security Operations SME in the Fintech industry, IEEE Senior Member, and Secretary of the IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES), Richmond Section. He is also an independent researcher and published author with interests spanning network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, and emerging AI applications.

With over 14 years of experience spanning enterprise infrastructure, AI, security, and application development, he specializes in building resilient, scalable platforms and modernizing operations through automation.

His background includes expertise in network architecture, load balancing, cloud technologies, scripting, and enterprise systems, with previous experience supporting global technology organizations including Microsoft. Pushpjeet is passionate about leveraging emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and business outcomes.

position: AI/ML Data Associate II, Artificial General Intelligence
bio: Rahman works in Artificial General Intelligence at Amazon, focusing on multimodal AI evaluation, data quality, and agentic AI systems. His work spans AI/ML, LLM-powered systems, and applied AI, with a background in software development and data analytics. He previously worked with Harvard University’s Division of Continuing Education, supporting data and technology initiatives, and has built AI-powered applications focused on automation and intelligent systems.

Dr. Sarah Bird is the Chief Product Officer of Responsible AI at Microsoft. She leads a team that works across the company to help make AI systems trustworthy - both for Microsoft and for customers building with AI - by surfacing emerging risks, creating ways to test for them, and building mitigations and controls to help build AI systems responsibly. 

An expert in responsible AI implementation, Sarah has helped teams develop and ship major AI products responsibly, including GitHub Copilot and Microsoft’s Copilot experiences, bringing together the right mix of research, product, and policy to translate responsible AI principles into real-world engineering practices. Sarah led the product development of responsible AI tools including Fairlearn, SmartNoise, and InterpretML. Sarah was one of the founding researchers in the Microsoft FATE research group.

Shafik Quoraishee is currently a Senior Android Games Engineer that works on the New York Times Games Team, working on the integration of games such as Wordle, Connections and the NYT Crossword, into the NYT Games Android App.

He is also an A.I. enthusiast and practitioner with multiple years experience in the field and published research that has been deployed across  real world systems with both civilian to government applications.

Sharon Gadonniex is a technology executive with more than 20 years of experience building and scaling engineering organizations across financial services, insurance, and consumer technology. 

As Senior Director of Software Engineering at Capital One, she leads teams driving AI transformation, platform modernization, and cloud-native engineering. Sharon is passionate about developing high-performing teams, advancing engineering excellence, and helping organizations use AI to create lasting business impact.

Shashank Viswanadha is a Staff Software Engineer at Google DeepMind, where he focuses on advancing agentic AI through post-training data strategies for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), and on designing robust simulation environments and “gyms” to support autonomous agents.

Before moving into AI research, Shashank built high-performance trading systems for options and futures markets at major financial institutions including Morgan Stanley, BNP Paribas, and UBS.

Dr. Shovon is Director of the AI Center of Excellence at Fidelity Investments, where he leads the development of enterprise AI solutions across generative AI, machine learning, explainable AI, and reinforcement learning. 

With more than 18 years of experience spanning applied research and production AI systems, his work focuses on building trustworthy, scalable AI for highly regulated environments. 

His expertise includes LLMs, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, causal inference, and graph machine learning. A published researcher and international speaker, he has presented at leading AI and forecasting conferences and is passionate about advancing responsible AI through research, education, and real-world enterprise applications.

Shridhar Pathak is Senior Director of Artificial Intelligence and Data at Moderna, where he leads AI strategy across manufacturing, quality, and regulated healthcare workflows, bringing large language models and multimodal AI into enterprise operations at scale.

Previously, he spent more than 11 years at Amazon leading major Alexa initiatives - including multi-agent conversational AI, global product launches, and enterprise AI platforms - and holds an Executive MBA from MIT Sloan with additional entrepreneurship studies at Harvard Business School.

Siby Alappatt is Vice President of Engineering at Instacart, leading the Platform organization responsible for the mission-critical systems powering consumer, retailer, and enterprise experiences. With over 20 years of engineering leadership experience, he has led global teams across large-scale SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, commerce, and AI-driven services. 

Previously, he was Executive Director of Engineering at IBM, where he led a global team of 200+ engineers. Siby is passionate about building scalable, reliable technology, accelerating innovation, and developing high-performing engineering teams. At Instacart, he is helping advance AI-powered grocery commerce, platform modernization, and developer productivity.

Subrata Das is Principal AI and Data Scientist and part-time Gen AI professor, with experience across machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, NLP and generative AI. He has led research programs in data fusion and analytics funded by DARPA and NASA. He currently teaches graduate NLP and Gen AI courses at Northeastern University and is the author of multiple books on AI and analytics, contributing through teaching, writing and seminars.

Sumita Palanisamy is Lead Director of AI and Automation at CVS Health, where she leads the delivery of enterprise AI applications and drives the development of scalable, production-ready solutions. With more than 15 years of experience spanning software engineering, machine learning, automation, and product development, she has built and led high-performing engineering teams across healthcare, automotive technology, and SaaS. 

Previously a Director of Engineering at CarGurus, she championed AI adoption, modernized engineering workflows, and developed impactful AI-powered products. Sumita is a passionate advocate for responsible AI, agentic workflows, and customer-centric innovation, and regularly speaks, mentors, and contributes to the broader technology community.
